criterion 1.description: States Technology IP annual book amortization (pre-tax) is USD 16.98 million (acceptable range is USD 16.81 to 17.15)
criterion 1.justification: Technology IP value: relief from royalty PV in EUR using royalty 2.5%, tax 25%, WACC 12%, 10 year revenue forecast and forex rate of 1.1 is EUR 154.33 million * 1.1 = USD 169.77 million. Annual book amortization: USD 169.77 million/ 10 years useful life = USD 16.98 million

criterion 2.description: States Customer relationship annual book amortization (pre-tax) is USD 82.50 million (acceptable range is 81.68 to 83.33)
criterion 2.justification: Stated fair value of Customer relationship in Orion_Target is EUR 900 million * 1.1 (Forex rate) = USD 990.00. Annual book amortization: fair value of customer relationship divided by the stated useful life. 990/12 = USD 82.50 million

criterion 3.description: States inventory step up year 1 after-tax net income impact is USD 123.75 million (acceptable range 122.51 to 124.99)
criterion 3.justification: Given inventory step-up value EUR 150 million translated to USD. 150*1.1 = USD 165 million. Translated inventory step-up adjusted for tax = 165 * (1-0.25) = USD 123.75 million

criterion 4.description: States deferred revenue haircut Year-1 after-tax net income reduction = USD 44.55million (acceptable range is 44.10m to 45.00)
criterion 4.justification: Deferred revenue haircut: EUR 180 (Pre-close deferred revenue) * 30% (haircut) * 1.1 (forex rate) = USD 59.40 million. This deferred revenue is recognized evenly over 12 months, accordingly the USD full 59.40 million in year 1. The calculated deferred revenue haircut adjusted for tax rate: 59.40 * (1 − 0.25) = USD 44.55 million.

criterion 5.description: States opening fair value of identifiable net assets is USD 1,989.17 million (acceptable range is 1,969.28 to USD 2,009.06 )
criterion 5.justification: Total of all net assets: 605.00 (Other net assets, from Orion_Target) + 169.77 (Tech) + 990.00 (Customer relationship) + 165.00 (Inventory) + 59.40m (Deferred revenue opening) = USD 1,989.17 million.

criterion 6.description: States Goodwill is USD 11,870.83 million (acceptable range 11,752.12 to 11,989.54m)
criterion 6.justification: Total consideration transferred is 70% of equity value of target in USD. Equity value of target in USD: EUR 52.50 (offer price) * 240.00 (no. of shares) * 1.10 (forex rate) = USD 13,860.00 million. Total consideration: 13,860.00 * 70% = USD 9,702.00 million NCI's 30% (1-0.7) of total target equity value: 30% * 13,860.00 = USD 4,158.00 million. USD 9,702.00 million (consideration) + USD 4,158.00 million (NCI) − USD 1,989.17 million (identifiable net assets, from 29066) = USD 11,870.83 million

criterion 7.description: States Section 382 NOL benefit is USD 13.75m (acceptable range 13.61 to 13.89)
criterion 7.justification: min(EUR 50 (limit), EUR 400m (available NOL)) = EUR 50 million. EUR 50 * 1.10 (fx rate) = USD 55.00 million. USD 55.00m * 25% (tax rate) = USD 13.75 million.

criterion 8.description: States Section 338 Year-1 tax shield is USD 120.41 million (acceptable range 119.21 to 121.61)
criterion 8.justification: Eligible basis Y1 = 60% * (Goodwill USD 11,870.83 + Tech USD 169.77) = USD 7,224.36; annual tax amort = USD 7,224.36m ÷ 15 = USD 481.62; tax shield = USD 481.62m * 25% = USD 120.41 million.

criterion 9.description: States after-tax convertible interest effect for if-converted is USD 23.73 million (acceptable range 23.49 to 23.97)
criterion 9.justification: Cash leg of the total consideration is total consideration * 50%: 9,702.00*50% = USD 4,851.00 million Gross principal sized to net USD 6,171.00m (cash leg USD 4,851.00 + target net debt EUR 1,200 * 1.10 = USD 1,320.00): Gross Principal = (6,171.00 + 31.25 (issuance fees))/0.98 = USD 6,328.83; coupon @ 0.50% = USD 31.64; after-tax USD 31.64 * 0.75 = USD 23.73 million

criterion 10.description: States NCI share of adjusted target Year-1 net income is USD 26.13 million (acceptable range 25.87 to 26.39)
criterion 10.justification: Target NI is EUR 300m * 1.10 = USD 330.00; less sub-level PPA after-tax (Tech IP amortization 12.73 (16.98*0.75)) + Customer relationship amortization 61.88 (82.5*0.75) + inventory step-up after tax 123.75 (165*0.75) + deferred revenue haircut 44.55 (59.40*0.75) = USD 242.91. Adjusted target NI USD 87.09; NCI 30% * USD 87.09 = USD 26.13 million

criterion 11.description: States Year-1 net income to common (basic) is USD 1,371.39 (acceptable range 1,357.68 to 1,385.10)
criterion 11.justification: USD 1,200.00 (acquirer net income) + USD 60.97 (controlling share of adjusted target; NCI share/0.3*0.7; 26.13/0.3*0.7) − USD 23.73 (after-tax convert, from 29075) + USD 13.75 (from 29073) + USD 120.41 = USD 1,371.39 million.

criterion 12.description: States US GAAP diluted EPS is USD 1.00 (acceptable range 0.99 to 1.01)
criterion 12.justification: Stock % of the total consideration transferred: 9,702.00 (from 29066) * 0.50 = USD 4,851.00 million. Total stock consideration / acquirer share price. 4,851.00m/ 25.00 = 194.04 million shares (shares issued for stock leg) Diluted NI USD 1,371.39 (from 29077) + USD 23.73 (from 29075) = USD 1,395.12 Diluted shares = 1000 (acquirer shares)+194.04 (shares issued for stock leg) + 202.52 (conversion shares: Gross principal/ conversion price: 6,328.83/31.25) = 1,396.56 Diluted EPS: USD 1,395.12/ 1,396.56 = USD 1.00.

criterion 13.description: States Economic diluted EPS is USD 1.15 (acceptable range 1.14 to 1.16)
criterion 13.justification: Stock % of the total consideration transferred: 9,702.00 (from 29066) * 0.50 = USD 4,851.00 million. Total stock consideration / acquirer share price. 4,851.00m/ 25.00 = 194.04 million shares (shares issued for stock leg) Purchased call fully offsets convert shares at average price USD 40.00 ≤ USD 45.00 cap; diluted NI = basic USD 1,371.39 (from 29077); diluted shares = basic 1,194.04 (1000 acquirer + 194.04 shares from stock leg); USD 1,371.39/ 1,194.04 = USD 1.15 (to cents).

criterion 14.description: States dilution vs standalone (US GAAP) is −16.67% (acceptable range is −17.67% to −15.67%)
criterion 14.justification: Standalone EPS = USD 1.20 (= USD 1,200.00 (acquirer net income) ÷ 1,000.00). (USD 1.00 ÷ USD 1.20) − 1 = −16.67%.

criterion 15.description: States dilution vs standalone (Economic) = −4.17% (acceptable range −5.17% to −3.17%)
criterion 15.justification: Economic diluted EPS / Standalone EPS (USD 1.15 ÷ USD 1.20 (1,200/1000)) − 1 = −4.17%.
